standard.summary: balanced 优先 output/mid 高收益 block

standard_en.summary: balanced favours the high-payoff output/mid blocks
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.balanced: Swaps precision on the output/mid blocks that pay off most, first.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Takes in more blocks: both the payoff and the risk are larger.

advanced.principle: balanced 优先 output/mid 高收益 block；aggressive 会选择更多候选 block

advanced_en.principle: balanced prioritizes high-yield output/mid blocks; aggressive selects more candidate blocks.
